verses.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying, “To you I give these commands.”
verses.2: They said to the children of Israel, “This is the life that you will eat from all the animals that live on the earth.”
verses.3: All those things are scattered and scattered everywhere. They’re spread out across the ground, like seeds that are scattered on the soil. You will eat them.
verses.4: But you shall not eat it from above the ground or from among the plants. The ground itself is not a good place to plant seeds; nor are the plants that grow there clean. They are not suitable for eating.
verses.5: And the tongue, which is what raises up the prideful person. It does not spread out; it is a thing that is filthy. It belongs to you.
verses.6: And the arneth is like a high hill; it’s not spread out in a messy manner. It’s something that’s not of poor quality.
verses.7: And he spread it out like a carpet. He scattered it everywhere. It became a place where no dirt could settle on it. It was meant for you.
verses.8: Do not eat their flesh, and do not touch their bones. They are unclean for you.
verses.9: You shall eat from all that is in the water: everything that has fins and scales. You shall eat them in the seas and in the rivers.
verses.10: And all that has no value and is worthless in the days and months ahead. All those things that are from the waters, and all those living creatures that live in the waters—they are all worthless to you.
verses.11: And their carcasses shall be for food for you. Do not eat them, and do not touch their carcasses.
verses.12: Everything that has no “snaffir” and “kashkesh” in the waters – that’s what you have here.
verses.13: And these shall be separated from the rest. They shall not be eaten; their flesh, their kidneys, their pears, and their olives shall not be eaten.
verses.14: And the pain and suffering according to their kind.
verses.15: All the evenings are of their own kind.
verses.16: And the daughter of Ya’anah, and the Takhmas, and the Shachaf, and the Neyz, according to their kind.
verses.17: And the pot, and the shovel, and the basin.
verses.19: And the leprous woman according to her kind, and the leper and the impure person.
verses.20: All that is alive and moves on four legs, that is for you.
verses.21: But you shall eat this from all that is eaten by the four-footed animals, which walk on all fours. Their feet are planted firmly on the ground.
verses.22: You shall eat these from among them: the liver, according to its kind; the kidneys, according to their kind; the fat of animals, according to their kind; and the heart, according to its kind.
verses.23: And all those birds with four legs are for you.
verses.24: And all those who touch their carcasses will be covered in filth, until dawn.
verses.25: And all those who are captured from their homes will be covered with their own clothes, and they will remain in a state of dirt until morning.
verses.26: To all those animals that produce offspring, and those that are not yet fertile or have not yet given birth, they are all impure for you. Anyone who touches them will also become impure.
verses.27: And all things walk upon their heads during all their lives. They walk on four feet. All those who touch their bodies will be covered in dirt until dawn.
verses.28: And whoever carries their corpses will be covered in their clothes. They will remain unclean until morning. How unclean you are!
verses.29: And this is what you call “the dirt” in the land of those who are covered in filth and decay. It’s a place where people are placed according to their kinds.
verses.30: And the Anaka, and the Khochah, and the Latah, and the Homet, and the Tinshamet.
verses.31: These are the things that are filthy for you in all kinds of places. Anyone who touches them will be covered in dirt until morning.
verses.32: And everything that falls upon them will be contaminated by them. It will be tainted by all kinds of trees, clothes, or other objects made from these materials. Everything that is made from these materials and is used in water-related activities will also be tainted until morning, and then it will be purified.
verses.33: And every branch that falls from them shall be thrown into the fire. All that is in them shall be destroyed, and they shall be burned up.
verses.34: From all food that is eaten, from all drinks that come into contact with water, and from all substances that are consumed, they will be destroyed.
verses.35: And everything that falls from their branches, it will be covered with dirt. Their idols will also be destroyed; they will become filthy and unclean to you.
verses.36: But the waters of the river will become clean, and those who touch them will be cleansed.
verses.37: And when they fall from their positions, they will affect every seed that is planted.
verses.38: And when water is poured over the seeds, and they fall from their pods onto them, then they become rotten. This is what happens to you.
verses.39: And when the animal that is meant for your food dies from its wound, it will be buried until morning.
verses.40: And whoever eats from her carcass shall be unclean until evening. And whoever takes her carcass away shall also be unclean until evening.
verses.41: And all the animals that live on the earth—those animals cannot be eaten.
verses.42: All things move along in a circular path. All things move around the four cardinal points. For all the animals that live on the earth, they will not be able to eat anything, because they are cursed by God.
verses.43: Do not pierce your souls with all kinds of thorns and briers. Do not cover them with them; let them remain covered by them.
verses.44: For I am the LORD your God. Be holy, for I am holy. Do not defile your souls with all the evil things that are on the earth.
verses.45: For I, the LORD, will lift you up from the land of Egypt, so that you may become my gods. You will be holy, for I am holy.
verses.46: This is the law for cattle, birds, and all living creatures that live in the waters. It also applies to all creatures that live on the land.
verses.47: It is necessary to distinguish between the impure and the pure, between the edible life and the life that cannot be eaten.
